body: The farm's hand-drawn boundary map has one line added a day after the rest, marked 'restricted' in a different pen. Folded into it is a gate log recording only field crew return times, no names, and a spare padlock key still on its string.
title: One line added a day later
gloss: A boundary map's late-added restricted line sits with a gate log of field crew return times.
rival_reading: A farm can add its own restricted line to a boundary map for routine security any day it likes; field crew return times and a spare key do not by themselves show an emergency order.

body: The clipboard lists three field rows, each checked against a time; the middle time matches a road closure on no other sheet at the farm. The bottle beside it is capped with tape instead of a lid seal, its signature line blank.
title: Three rows, one matching a closure nobody logged
gloss: Three timed field rows include one matching a road closure recorded nowhere else, beside a taped bottle and a blank signature.
rival_reading: A farm crew could just as easily check off three timed rows against its own field schedule with no closure involved; a taped cap and a blank signature do not by themselves show a program malfunction.
